name: cross-chain-dca
description: Cross-chain DCA template: Hedera DcaOrchestrator schedules recurring swaps executed on Sepolia via Axelar GMP and Uniswap v3.

steps: This template deploys contracts to two live testnets — Hedera testnet (chain 296) and Ethereum Sepolia (chain 11155111). It cannot run on a local chain.
1. Copy the env file: packages/hardhat/.env.example → packages/hardhat/.env, if you want to modify or add env variables manually go directly to the packages/hardhat/ file and make the changes there
2. Generate or import deployer accounts for both chains: {run:hardhat:account:generate}
Fund your accounts before deploying — Hedera testnet: https://portal.hedera.com, Sepolia: https://sepolia-faucet.pk910.de/
3. Run the full 10-step deployment (compile, deploy, wire, fund, create plan, verify): {run:hardhat:deploy}
5. Further develop this template with our agentic harness: {run:harness:run}
After this, inspect the active plan with {run:hardhat:hedera:plan:latest} or check Sepolia balances with {run:hardhat:sepolia:balance:check}.
